items.title: George Lewis Interview, 1958-11-14
items.q: And Billy, Billy Chase was playing piano. He was on the four of us.

ctx.x: Was that every night or just on weekends? Every night. Every night.

Who was playing with you in some of those jumps? Well, the first one I was at Kingfish was Boyd's. Boyd's was playing trumpet. Boyd's Stevens was playing trumpet. Boyd's. And the guy by the name of McGee was playing drum. And Billy, Billy Chase was playing piano. He was on the four of us.
Now McGee, is that, that's Herb Moran?
